veranderings.rede: 'Oor en oor' is a calque of English 'over and over'; 'keer op keer' is the Afrikaans idiom, same word count.
AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses each with its own subject and verb (plase hou aan / ander plant).

veranderings.voor: Daar woon min mense en daar is
veranderings.na: Daar woon min mense, en daar is
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full clauses (daar woon min mense / daar is min winkels).

veranderings.voor: groter as 'n dorpie en die huise staan
veranderings.na: groter as 'n dorpie, en die huise staan
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two full clauses (dorp is / huise staan).
AWS 2017: the second 'en' joins a new clause (die verkeer is), not a list item; the protected word stays intact.

vlae.teks: Daar woon min mense en daar is min winkels en dienste. Die mense van die dorpie en die plase rondom deel sy winkel en sy skool.
vlae.rede: 'Min winkels' (plural) is followed by 'sy winkel' (one shop); fixing it means choosing between one shop and a few, which is content, so it is flagged rather than changed.
